segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Parting the swirling storm clouds, an enormous, magnificent hot-air balloon descended out of the sky.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The balloon envelope was colossal—shaped like a round holiday ornament made of thick, quilted canvas with vibrant red-and-white peppermint stripes. Hanging beneath the burner was an oversized wicker gondola reinforced with polished copper pipes and brass fog lamps.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The balloon drifted down toward the roof peak, its twin propane burners roaring: WHOOOOOOSH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Standing at the brass steering helm of the basket was the pilot.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You blink in disbelief.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was an American Bulldog. But not just any bulldog—he was a towering, broad-chested powerhouse of a dog with massive muscular shoulders, a big square head, and a brilliant white coat sprinkled with tiny black freckles across his muzzle and ears. He wore a shearling-lined leather bomber jacket, a fleece-lined aviator cap, and a pair of brass flight goggles perched over two big, soulful, chocolate-brown eyes. His little docked tail was clamped down tight in nervousness.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When he stepped up to the edge of the basket, he looked so big and formidable that the Nutcrackers on the ground actually paused their marching in sheer intimidation.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then the wicker basket bumped the mill chimney with a gentle thud.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The giant bulldog let out a sharp, pathetic squeak:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: EEP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He dropped flat onto his belly in the bottom of the basket, threw both of his massive, muscular white paws over his ears, and began shivering so violently the entire gondola rattled!

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: O-Oh goodness! Oh crumpets and cocoa!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the bulldog whimpered in a deep, booming voice that sounded like a giant bag of rocks being gently shaken.

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: Tell me it was just a chimney! Tell me it wasn't an airborne snow-monster! Pip! Pip, are you down there?! I am having a medical crisis of pure fear!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip scrambled across the snowy roof and grabbed the rim of the basket.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Titan! Pull yourself together, man! We are under active hostile fire!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The bulldog peeked one eye out from under his spotted ear. He spotted you, gasped, and tried to squeeze his giant body behind a tiny sandbag:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A human?! A real human?! D-Do they bite?! Are they dangerous?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Down on the ground, the Nutcracker soldiers recovered from their shock and raised their brass staves!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRACK-CRACK-CRACK!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Luminous webs of sticky, glowing silver tinsel nets shot upward from the courtyard, latching onto the mill gutters and tearing toward the balloon basket!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Titan!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip screamed, diving over the wicker rim.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Engage the burners! Fly, you glorious coward, FLY!
